C1212.title: Nine Indicted in SIM Swapping Criminal Ring
C1212.summary: In May 2019, eight U.S. nationals and one Irish national were indicted on wire fraud charges for allegedly hijacking phone numbers through SIM swapping. The group illicitly transferred victims' mobile numbers to controlled SIM cards, intercepting text messages and calls to take over online accounts.
